features.fullDescription: Two-storey mansion house, harl and slate with projecting wings, the westernmost enlarged and rebuilt c.1822, and back additions c.1830. Detached vaulted cellar may date 17th cent. Picturesque setting. Plans for new house by R. & R. Dickson, archts. Edinburgh, dated 1820, not carried out.
